verdict.rationale: Omarchy's docs say it offers AI dictation via Voxtype. You dictate by holding F9 or toggling with Super + Ctrl + X, and the text appears in whichever input area has focus, which covers dictating anywhere in the system. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that dictation works reliably, detail on the dictation model or accuracy, and clarity on the separate install step the docs imply ("once installed").
